name: Dense Spark
description: Pack a bead of fire so tightly that it strikes with the weight of a thrown stone.

name: Leaden Palm
description: Set the weight of the whole body behind a burning palm that sinks into the guard.

name: Rooted Coal
description: Sink the stance and let dense fire at the forearms take a heavy blow without giving ground.

name: Press Ember
description: Pin an opponent's weapon arm under a palm of dense heat until the grip loosens.

name: Slow Flare
description: Open the hand late in the swing so the burst of fire lands at the end of the arc.

name: Crushing Cinder
description: Drive a dense palm through a raised guard and let the packed fire burst inside the arm.

name: Weighted Lash
description: Whip a lash of fire that carries the weight of an iron chain and drives the target low.

name: Settled Blaze
description: Stand in a planted guard with dense fire held at the chest and arms through a long exchange.

name: Leaden Pyre
description: Bring down a burning fist with the full weight of the body and packed fire to split a shield rim or a heavy plank.

name: Sinking Blaze
description: Press dense fire into the ground so it rolls outward beneath the feet of nearby opponents and holds them low.

name: Floor Flame
description: Call a short tongue of fire up from the ground beneath the target's lead foot.

name: Pyre Seed
description: Plant a seed of fire qi in the ground to draw on again in the next breath.

name: Rising Spark
description: Lift a column of sparks that climbs and burns the face and hands of the target.

name: Ash Rise
description: Raise a cloud of hot ash from the ground to blind and choke the target.

name: Pyre Column
description: Raise a tall column of flame beneath a group that scorches all inside it and flings burning embers outward.

name: Kindling Ring
description: Draw a ring of fire round the target that closes in slowly and holds them in place.

name: Wick Lift
description: Drag a line of fire up the target's body from the feet to the head in one rising cut.

name: Crown Pyre
description: Gather qi at the feet and then raise a great pyre round the user that ends in a rolling crown of flame.

name: Pillar Blaze
description: Throw up a tower of flame that bursts the footing of those near it and sends them reeling.

name: Coal Sense
description: Spread a faint fire field round the body and feel anything that enters it by its warmth.

name: Heat Halo
description: Wear a halo of heat round the body that scorches weapons reaching it.

name: Scattered Sparks
description: Fill the field with sparks and send them out in every direction at once.

name: Warm Draw
description: Draw the warmth from a target's limbs into the field so that the limbs slow and stiffen.

name: Radiant Step
description: Move inside the field as if on a floor of heat that pushes the foot forward.

name: Steady Scorch
description: Light the whole field so that anyone standing inside it takes steady burns.

name: Radiant Guard
description: Thicken the field before the body into a bright guard that takes a heavy strike.

name: Ember Pulse
description: Send a sudden pulse of heat from the field outward to knock back and unsettle nearby opponents.

name: Expanding Corona
description: Widen the fire field into a bright corona that burns everyone inside it and thins the user's reserve.

name: Flame Implosion
description: Draw the field in to the body and release it in a single flash that scorches all within a long reach.

name: Sear Needle
description: Narrow a flame to a needle that slips between the threads of a qi shield.

name: Shield Taste
description: Touch a target's qi shield with a fingertip of fire to feel where it is thin.

name: Hot Seam
description: Burn a seam in cloth armor and follow it with a second jet into the opening.

name: Strip Burn
description: Burn the outer layer of a qi shield away so that the next strike lands cleanly.

name: Qi Combustion
description: Ignite the qi that shapes the target's guard from within so that the guard burns itself away.

name: Shield Melt
description: Pour a thin steady fire into a qi shield until it softens and gives way.

name: Burning Through
description: Drive a spear of white fire through a barrier of qi in one thrust and burn the body behind it.

name: Guard Eater
description: Feed on the target's guard qi as it burns so the shield fails faster the harder it holds.

name: Paired Cinder
description: Throw a spark from each hand so that both reach the target at once from two sides.

name: Twin Ember
description: Light two small embers one at each palm to set a paired rhythm for the next moves.

name: Mirror Flame
description: Hold flame in both hands and cross them to turn a strike down and aside.

name: Double Burn
description: Strike with a burning palm and follow with the other before the guard resets.

name: Paired Flit
description: Step in two quick motions with a flare beneath each heel to change the angle of attack.

name: Paired Warmth
description: Hold two warm palms against an ally's chest and back to ease a wound from both sides.

name: Twin Fire Lash
description: Whip a fire lash from each hand across the target in a crossing pattern.

name: Dual Screen
description: Raise two sheets of fire side by side so the second takes what breaks through the first.

name: Echo Flame
description: Repeat a fire strike with the second hand a heartbeat later so the burn lands twice.

name: Matched Pyres
description: Light two pyres at opposite ends of the target's reach and bring them together on the target.

name: Paired Surge
description: Close both burning hands on the target at once so that the two flames meet inside the guard.

name: Hawk Spark
description: Throw a spark that dives onto the target like a hawk from above.

name: Ember Wing
description: Spread a wing of ember light along the arm to guard the near side.

name: Sky Glow
description: Raise a glow overhead and read the heat on the ground beneath it.

name: Talon Burn
description: Hook curved fingers lit with fire into the target's shoulder to scorch the grip.

name: Stooping Flame
description: Drop from a height on a burst of heat and strike with a flame-wrapped fist.

name: Ember Plume
description: Spread burning plumes wide through the air so that they fall on everyone below.

name: Pinion Brand
description: Beat both fire wings together to knock a heavy strike aside.

name: Hawkfire Stoop
description: Rise on a column of heat and fall on the target in a diving burn that trails embers.

name: Burning Pinion
description: Sweep a great wing of fire across the field in a slow arc that burns all it passes.

name: Track Spark
description: Send one bolt straight and one in a curve so that they strike together.

name: Split Glow
description: Hold two glowing points apart and read the heat that passes between them.

name: Flame Duet
description: Run fire along two paths in the body in time with each other to raise the output of both.

name: Second Flame
description: Keep a hidden second shield of fire behind the first for the moment it fails.

name: Duality Step
description: Step one way in body while a flame image steps the other to split the eye.

name: Twin Burn
description: Run fire along both arms into a double strike with one hand high and one low.

name: Parallel Lash
description: Hold two long fire lashes and snap them one after the other along parallel lines.

name: Mirror Veil
description: Hold two overlapping veils of flame so that the true body is hard to place.

name: Twinned Inferno
description: Build two great fires on two tracks and release them together to scorch a wide area.

name: Track Cinder
description: Run a burning strike down each track in turn so the second lands in the opening made by the first.

name: Sworn Spark
description: Throw a spark with a short vow spoken and let the breath carry it faster.

name: Gust Ember
description: Ride a breath of wind to carry an ember farther and keep it lit.

name: Bearing Glow
description: Hold a small glow and read from the bend of its flame which way the air runs.

name: Oath Flame
description: Keep a flame lit before the chest that the user swears will not go out under a blow.

name: Windward Burn
description: Strike with the wind at the back so the flame on the fist leaps forward as it lands.

name: Fan Flame
description: Sweep the arms wide to fan a fire across a broad front.

name: Oathfed Blaze
description: Speak the oath of the flame and drive the fire through the guard in one burning stroke.

name: Bearing Flare
description: Take a clear bearing on the target and loose a long flare that burns everything along that line.

name: Standing Coal
description: Plant the feet and hold a glowing coal of qi at the center that takes the first blow.

name: Held Ember
description: Hold an ember at the chest through a long wait and keep its heat unchanged.

name: Open Palm Flame
description: Strike with an open palm of steady fire from a still stance.

name: Kindly Breath
description: Breathe slowly with an ally and warm their chest to calm panic and ease pain.

name: Steady Vow
description: Speak a vow of the flame aloud and feel it steady the grip and the breath.

name: Oath Burn
description: Hold a fixed stance and pour a steady stream of fire into the target.

name: Unmoved Blaze
description: Stand and let a heavy blow break on a thick bright flame that does not give ground.

name: Oath Ring
description: Draw a ring of fire on the ground and stand within it so that those who cross are held.

name: Unwavering Fire
description: Stand and send a vast steady fire outward that does not bend under any gust or blow.

name: Vow Eruption
description: Release the whole held flame in a single burst through the palm at the target.

name: Open Flame
description: Throw a bold flame in plain sight and keep it burning on the way.

name: Bearing Cinder
description: Send a spark in a circle and read the heat that returns to find any body near.

name: Spreading Glow
description: Spread a wide soft glow in front of the body that burns what touches it.

name: Scorch Hold
description: Draw a line of fire across the ground and hold a pursuer back from it.

name: Striding Flame
description: Take a long stride on a gust of heat and burn the target as the foot lands.

name: Descending Blaze
description: Drop a falling palm of fire from above the head onto the target's shoulder.

name: Clear Fire Bearing
description: Hold a clear line to the target and send a bolt then a lash then a palm in order.

name: Unhidden Fire
description: Stand in plain view and release a broad wave of fire that offers no cover.

name: Falling Pyre
description: Raise a great flame into the air and let it fall as a burning rain over a wide field.
